pairs.subject: watch-cache-and-resync
pairs.evidence: src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:275 computePersonaHealth fully re-reads a declared slice (getHealthBundle(7)), but a source that still fails after its one retry is written as [] or null over the last good values. healingFrequency then becomes 0, which inflates heartbeatScore, and the result is committed with a replica-wide healthLastRefreshedAt = now, so a failed read becomes a confident zero instead of unknown with the last good rows kept.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:275 A failed source falls back to empty and is scored and committed (set at :498-508). The technique requires a failed read to write nothing and to stay unknown. By contrast, overviewSlice runDashboardWave1/2 do conform: they use Promise.allSettled, then one set(), and a failed source's data is left untouched.

src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:506 There is one replica-wide refresh time, stamped even when dataSourceStatus marks sources failed, so a broken source looks freshly read. dataSourceStatus keeps a per-source failure reason but no per-source last-ok time. overviewSlice.ts:372 is the conformant counterpart in this same context: success clears the error and stamps fetchedAt[source], and failure leaves fetchedAt alone.

src/stores/slices/pipeline/channelSlice.ts:21 N surfaces share one refcounted subscription (subscribeChannel). When a key's refcount reaches 0 it is deleted (:296), so the shared poll stops refreshing it. That is the fan-out-plus-reaping shape. The backpressure clause is moot for a polled source.

src/stores/slices/overview/healingSlice.ts:125 Tauri events invalidate and the slice re-reads through IPC. No cursor or position is kept, so there is no positional-failure family to model. A search of src/stores for resync, desync, resourceVersion and bookmark found nothing.

src/stores/slices/overview/eventSlice.ts:30 The event list is a bounded window of 200 items that merges fetched rows with pushed events. It is not a full-slice re-read of a stream-maintained replica, so there is no begin/complete marker to swap at.

src/stores/slices/overview/memorySlice.ts:18 No convergence loop consumes these slices. The related concern, that an empty unfilled store must not read as an empty slice, is handled with a loading flag plus error fields (memoriesLoading/memoriesError, recentEventsError), not a one-shot barrier.

src/stores/slices/pipeline/channelSlice.ts:34 Reads go to the app's own local backend over IPC, which has no rate limit shared with humans. Each refresh is already a bounded single page, with no per-item detail fan-out.

pairs.registryProposal: The golden path frames the polled replica around 'hosted platforms a product integrates with'. In a desktop app, the same failure (a failed source written as empty and stamped fresh) occurs in a UI read model over the app's own local backend whose slice is declared rather than caller-keyed. The standard could say explicitly whether a declared, fully re-read derived bundle over a local source falls under the polled-replica techniques or under client-fetch-cache.
